From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Turner <amanda.turner@gmail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Park <susan@talentbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Virtual loop: candidate preflight + escort plan

Hi all —

Thanks for agreeing to join Amanda Turner’s virtual full loop next week. Goal here is to pin the panel sequence, confirm slots, and decide who will own the 5–10 minute candidate escort / handoff between tracks. Quick summary and proposed schedule below.

Candidate: Amanda Turner (mobile: +1 415-555-0198) — current timezone: PDT (UTC-7)
Role: Senior Backend Engineer (Platform team)
Interview length: 4 x 45min slots + 30min debrief
Proposed sequence (PDT):
- 10:00–10:45 — System design (Karthik)
- 11:00–11:45 — Coding (Marissa)
- 12:00–12:45 — Product/Roles & Context (Laura)
- 14:00–14:45 — Culture / Leadership (Naomi)

Notes / asks:
- We left 15min buffer between slot 1 and 2, and 15 min between 2 and 3 for short breaks and re-connects. Karthik, if you need the system-design slot earlier/later, flag now.
- We’d like one of us to be the candidate escort — quick check-in 5 minutes before the first slot and a 3–4 minute handoff after each slot to keep Amanda oriented. Who can own the escort?
- Attached: candidate resume (amanda_turner_resume.pdf) and a first-draft panel pack (virtual_panel_pack_v1.pdf). I’ll update the panel pack after we confirm sequence.

Amanda — are you ok with the proposed times? If not, please share 2 other windows and we’ll shuffle. Also, one preflight ask: please complete the short environment check (mic/camera/network) and this 5-question form we use to tailor the loop: https://forms.redwood.com/preflight/Amanda (takes ~3 min).

Thanks — I’ll hold off on sending invites until we confirm.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Recruiting Lead, Engineering Hiring Programs
Redwood Inference

Thanks Naomi — I can do the coding slot at 11:00–11:45. One ask: would you mind having the coding session focus on one focused API-design + implementation exercise rather than multiple micro-tasks? I find candidates do better and it’s easier to score consistently.

I can take escort duty for the first two handoffs (pre-first slot quick check + immediate 3-min handoff after system design). If Amanda is on earlier, I can be available for the coding handoff as well.

No attachment from me — just confirming cadence.

—Marissa

Thanks — small request from my side: can we swap the order so the Product/Roles & Context slot (Laura) is before the coding exercise? My concern is we usually get better behavioral/context signals up front and it helps tailor the coding prompt to a real team scenario. Proposed adjusted sequence:

- 10:00–10:45 — System design (Karthik) [keep timing]
- 11:00–11:45 — Product / Roles & Context (Laura) [swap]
- 12:00–12:45 — Coding (Marissa) [swap]
- 14:00–14:45 — Culture / Leadership (Naomi)

Also recommend a 10-minute buffer instead of 15 between slot 2 and 3 to keep the day from stretching; we can keep 15 between 1 and 2 given cross-team setup. I uploaded a short panel pack revision (virtual_panel_pack_v1.pdf) with an explicit scoring rubric at page 3 — see the shared Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PanelPackShared).

I’m happy to let Marissa handle escort duty if she prefers.

Karthik
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
